sections.Project Setup: Context: define the product concept, target user, job, problem, prototype, and main value hypothesis.
sections.Assessment: Estimate: assess all five dimensions, record questions and assumptions, and compare against an optional historical product.
sections.AI Safety: Assess six safety design checkpoints. Coverage is not a claim that the product is safe.
sections.Self-Improvement: Describe and classify each AI-assisted improvement loop separately.
sections.Backlog creator: Hypothesize: derive supporting hypotheses from your questions and assumptions and connect them to value.
sections.Prioritization: Prioritize: rank hypotheses by risk and evidence and plan the next experiment.
sections.Summary & Export: Review: inspect checklist progress and download the product record.
sections.Project History: Review changes made to this product.
